name: Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion
label: Quest
description: Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.
All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do you know what the troops on the front lines call these? Priests in a bottle...
"I'm your priest in a bott-le baby... You gotta drink me the right way..."
What's the matter sonny? It's a very popular song around these parts.
